sample_unit: models and model committees evaluated on the synthetic AnonyMed-BR dataset
models_evaluated: 28 open-weight LLMs and model committees (local, prompted)

links.outcome: PII removal recall and precision of local hybrid LLM de-identification pipeline on synthetic Brazilian Portuguese notes
links.effect: End-to-end pipeline F2 0.9341, recall 0.9537, precision 0.8634; best single model gemma4:26b F2 0.9595. Residual missed PII remains (about 4.6% of PII not detected).
links.quote: These findings demonstrate the technical feasibility and high recall of institutionally controlled, local de-identification without requiring task-specific model fine-tuning.

unlisted_practices: Detector cascade to interrupt repetitive-generation loops in LLM inference
Withholding recurrent boilerplate text from neural inference via n-gram detection
Offline local deployment of open-weight LLMs for data sovereignty

screen.reason: Evaluates an offline hybrid LLM pipeline for clinical de-identification with explicit safeguards (recurrent n-gram boilerplate filtering, regex, and a 4-detector cascade to interrupt repetitive generation loops) on synthetic and real clinical notes.

primary.practice: local hybrid de-identification pipeline with loop detection guardrail
